query:
update site_info set
               operator_name = $1, street = $2, postal_code = $3, city = $4,
               country = $5, email = $6, phone = $7, vat_id = $8,
               register_number = $9, responsible = $10, purpose = $11,
               modified_by = $12, modified = now()
           where id = 1
